# Champion Auto Finance

> Champion Auto Finance is a New Jersey–based, NJ DOBI–licensed auto financing partner (not a lender) that coordinates lease buyout financing for drivers in New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania, and runs a dealer wholesale network in New Jersey. Located at 1935 Swarthmore Avenue, Lakewood, NJ 08701 · (732) 618-2036 · info@championautofinance.com.

Key facts:

- Champion Auto Finance is a licensed financing partner, **not a lender**. Approvals, rates, and terms are always set by the funding lender, subject to underwriting and applicable law.
- Core service: **lease buyout financing** — helping a driver finance the residual (payoff) amount of their vehicle lease so they own the car instead of returning it. This avoids excess-mileage and wear-and-tear return charges.
- Champion works one application privately to get the applicant the best rate possible, whatever their credit situation; a customer's information is shared only as needed to fund their deal.
- B2B: Champion runs a **dealer wholesale network** in New Jersey — independent dealers who buy and sell inventory with Champion. Champion does not offer dealer financing programs.
- In New Jersey, a lease buyout is generally treated as a vehicle purchase: NJ Sales & Use Tax typically applies to the buyout price, and title/registration is processed through the NJ Motor Vehicle Commission (NJ MVC). Taxes and MVC fees can often be financed into the buyout loan.
- Typical process: get the payoff quote from the leasing company → apply with Champion → review clear terms (rate, term, payment) → the lender pays off the leasing company and the title transfers to the driver.
- Service area: New Jersey (statewide), New York, and Pennsylvania.
